sentences.en: The new film Green Book is rolling out across the country.

sentences.zh: 这是一个了不起的故事，也是我最喜欢的节目之一。

sentences.en: As a special bonus in this episode, we'll also be playing a Green Book story from Nate DeMeo of the Memory Palace.
sentences.zh: 作为本期的特别福利，我们还将播放一段来自《记忆宫殿》节目的内特·德梅奥讲述的绿皮书故事。

sentences.en: It makes me very happy to share them together today.
sentences.zh: 今天能把它们分享给大家，我感到非常高兴。

sentences.en: The 1940s, 50s, and 60s were the golden age of road travel.
sentences.zh: 20世纪40、50和60年代是公路旅行的黄金时代。

sentences.en: Cars had become cheap and roomy enough to carry families comfortably for hundreds of miles.
sentences.zh: 汽车变得便宜且宽敞，足以让一家人舒适地行驶数百英里。

sentences.en: The interstate highway system had started to connect the country's smaller roads into a vast nationwide network.
sentences.zh: 州际公路系统开始将全国的小路连接成一个庞大的网络。

sentences.en: Finally, tourists could make their way from New York to California,

sentences.zh: 摇下车窗，感受风吹过发梢，沿途欣赏美国的大好河山。

sentences.en: We have become the nation on wheels, with more motorized mobility than ever dreamed of before.
